title: digest request (v1)
description: Documentation of the digest input. The skill enforces the same rules, the path-pattern grammar and the size caps with explicit standard-library checks in the order instructions.md documents; this schema does not express the pattern grammar, the aggregate caps or the check order.

as_of.description: The last day of the window (UTC), included to 23:59:59Z.

since.description: The first day of the window (UTC), included from 00:00:00Z; not after as_of.

at.description: Before the window: dropped and counted. After it: FUTURE_EVENT.

title.description: Untrusted text: scanned for breaking terms and, for release and tag events, read as a version after one leading v when at most 64 characters remain and they are valid semver. Only that version reaches an output, in version_jumps; no other part of the title is echoed, and a host treats the version as untrusted data too.

paths.description: Paths a commit touched: matched against paths_of_interest, never echoed.

items.description: A whole-path pattern over the closed character set, with ?, * and ** as wildcards; at most 4 wildcards.
